scenario: LUNI.3.1 — `_` is optional in unit literals. Pin: `scope ttl 30s`, `cooldown 5min` and `within 10s`, three unit literals with no underscore, compile. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: no literal here has an underscore to compare with, and `compile_ok` does not read the nanosecond values.
rules_ds:

    entity_id: String
